text: {"status":"CONFLICT","claims":[{"text":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal Dropbox is prohibited.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"Uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, such as a personal Dropbox, personal Google Drive or personal OneDrive, is prohibited."},{"text":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely if the account is protected with multi-factor authentication.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Employees may store Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account when working remotely, provided the account is protected with multi-factor authentication."},{"text":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"Confidential and Restricted information must never be stored in personal cloud storage."},{"text":"The company's managed OneDrive and SharePoint are the approved storage locations for company work.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"The company's managed OneDrive and SharePoint are the approved storage locations for company work."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":["E1","E2"],"conflict_note":"E1 prohibits uploading company information classified Internal or above to a personal cloud-storage account, while E2 allows storing Internal information in a personal cloud-storage account for remote work if the account has multi-factor authentication."}
